brief.summary: Marc Odermatt asks how to contest the landlord’s stated intention to end his tenancy and which papers are needed. The caretaker orally said the owner wants him out by year-end, but the written letter has not arrived; exact dates and year are unclear. Request the lease, termination notice when received, receipt proof, and notice-period evidence. Request September defect/rent-reduction correspondence and any reply. Clarify whether this is his family home and whether an extension is relevant. Arrears are not discussed.

questions.extension_relevant: Would you seek an extension of the lease if the termination takes effect?

clauses.text: We have recorded that you are still waiting for the written termination notice.
Please send us the lease contract and, as soon as you receive it, the termination notice, together with any envelope, delivery record or other proof showing when and how it reached you.
Please also provide any documents showing the agreed notice period and the relevant termination dates.

Please send copies of your September letters about the water leak and rent reduction and any reply or other correspondence from the landlord, so that we can assess the chronology and the reason given for the termination.
Please let us know whether the flat is your family home and whether you may need an extension of the tenancy.
